verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships a well-documented official CLI for secret scanning (install via brew/docker, extensive flags like --include-detectors, --only-verified, analyze subcommand), but this is a security scanning CLI, not an AI-native/agentic CLI — there's no evidence of agent-oriented features like structured tool-call output, MCP integration, or LLM-agent workflows. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI design (e.g., structured JSON for agent consumption, agentic workflow integration, or explicit AI-native tooling support) beyond generic scripting flags.
